name: Digital Realty

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Digital Realty TM Brandmark RGB Black.svg)

description: Digital Realty is a real estate investment trust that owns and operates 310 data centers (89 of them held through unconsolidated joint ventures) across six continents, about 57.6 million rentable square feet including 9.7 million under development. Tenants (cloud and software companies, IT services, financial firms) pay rent for space and power under multi-year leases, plus fees for interconnection; revenue was $6.1B in 2025 (+10%) and $3.56B in H1 2026 (+23%) on AI-driven demand. The largest tenant, a Fortune 50 software company, was 11.7% of annualized recurring revenue. It funds growth by issuing equity through an at-the-market program and by selling stakes in assets to joint ventures and funds.
